settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure download options, paths, and preferences

general.outputDirDesc: Where downloaded files will be saved
general.themeDesc: Choose between light and dark mode, or follow your OS setting
general.languageDesc: Application display language (requires restart to take full effect)
general.metadataLanguageDesc: Language preference for track and album metadata
general.overwriteDesc: Re-download and replace files that already exist in the output directory
general.autoStartDesc: Start processing immediately when items are added to the queue. When disabled, items are queued and you can start processing manually from the Queue page.
general.autoCheckDesc: Automatically check for GAMDL and tool updates on startup
general.preReleaseDesc: Check for pre-release versions in addition to stable releases. Pre-release versions may contain bugs or incomplete features and are not yet fully supported.

updates.title: Updates
